Security regressions iter14/15 re-run: 28 passed, 1 xfail. Frontend: /community 6 filter chips, arts -> 3 cards + URL ?category=, search 'nocturne' -> 1, submit link forms.gle target _blank, nocturne IG href correct with _blank, 5 featured badges, no broken images; detail page shows category/@handle/image/IG/website; example-nail-studio shows 'No Instagram listed.'; back -> /community; fresh tab back falls back to /community. Admin community tab: create pending listing via form, pending count badge, pending filter, approve (toast), feature, edit (header 'Edit Listing', rename saved), delete with confirm, programs/jobs/events tabs still render. issues: Category chips wrap into 5 rows (~212px tall) before search; consider a horizontally scrollable chip row on mobile (optional).
Right listings panel has large empty space below the scroll list because it stretches to the form height (cosmetic).

critical_code_review_comments: CommunityAdmin.del(): api.delete has no try/catch, so a failed delete gives no error toast.

CommunityAdmin.startEdit spreads the full listing (id, created_at, instagram_url, seeded) into the PUT payload; Pydantic ignores the extra fields, but it would be cleaner to send only ListingIn fields.

PUT /api/listings/{id} replaces the whole listing: if a client leaves out is_featured or status, they go back to the defaults (False / 'approved'). The admin UI always sends them, so it is fine today.
Any admin PATCH/PUT on a seeded listing sets seeded=False, so later seed changes to that listing in seed_data.py will no longer apply (as designed, but worth knowing).
The community search term is not kept in the URL, unlike category; a minor UX point.
seed_data_creation: None. QA listings created during tests (QA Nail Studio xxxxx, QA UI Test) were deleted; DB has 15 seeded listings, no QA leftovers.
